lenses.name: Land take per resident
lenses.description: Natural, agricultural and forest land consumed between 2011 and 2025 divided by 2022 residents. This intensity indicator normalizes cumulative land take by current population; it is not the annual population-adjusted standard used in some observatory dashboards. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice, so values are spatial indicators rather than parcel-level measurements.

lenses.name: Land consumed since 2011
lenses.description: Natural, agricultural and forest land consumed between 1 January 2011 and 1 January 2025 as a share of commune surface. This is cumulative land-take flow, not the total artificialized stock. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice, so values are spatial indicators rather than parcel-level measurements.

lenses.name: Recent land consumption
lenses.description: Natural, agricultural and forest land consumed between 1 January 2021 and 1 January 2025 as a share of commune surface. The short period makes this a recent-pressure indicator. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice, so values are spatial indicators rather than parcel-level measurements.

lenses.name: Housing-driven land take
lenses.description: Share of 2011–2025 natural/agricultural/forest land consumption assigned to housing use in the Cerema land-registry typology. Null where there was no measured consumption. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice, so values are spatial indicators rather than parcel-level measurements.

lenses.name: Wetland cover
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as inland or coastal wetland by CORINE Land Cover 2018. CORINE is a relatively coarse land-cover map and does not cover overseas territories in this extract.

lenses.name: Natural and semi-natural land
lenses.description: Combined CORINE forest, natural grassland, shrubland and wetland share. This is a structural land-cover proxy for ecological continuity, not a validated green-and-blue-corridor network; overseas territories are outside the CORINE extract.
